subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Vehicle physics and constraint-solver batch state, the SIMD matrix/vector math and fixed-point transform helpers that serve it, the audio sub-band transforms that reuse the same packed-float instruction style, the scene-node update path that consumes physics collision/visibility results, and the composite network/physics object teardown chain. Everything here is a DERIVED proposal over validated function IR; no original source identity is claimed.

summary: Twenty-two functions spanning SIMD matrix/vector math (3DNow!/MMX/SSE), a fixed-point quaternion pipeline with surface-table sampling, two audio sub-band transforms (32-point MDCT and MMX synthesis), the vehicle physics joint/constraint solver batch state, physics-state field accessors, a scene-node update that consumes collision/visibility results, and a composite network/physics destructor chain. None of the owner objects are established (all owner evidence is UNKNOWN or a DERIVED prelabel); the grouping into classes below is a DERIVED proposal justified only by shared field bases, shared global tables, and structural-twin relationships stated in the packet.

function_roles.role: Constructs a 4x4 diagonal scale matrix over eight qword slots from three integer inputs using 3DNow! intrinsics; returns the matrix base pointer. The integer inputs are interpreted as bit patterns of floats by the caller.

3DNow!-intrinsic composition of a 4x4 transform from up to six optional packed-float inputs; every null input falls back to an identity component. The inverse-rotation product algorithm matches sub_522B5B. Returns the output matrix pointer.

MMX/3DNow!-intrinsic composition of a 4x4 transform from up to six optional packed-float inputs; structural twin of composeCompositeTransformMatrix3DNow (0x00522CE2) using _m_pswapd/_m_pfpnacc where the twin uses punpck. Returns the output matrix pointer.

Vector transform helper: builds a 4x4 transform into a local array by selecting up to three optional matrix inputs a6/a7/a8 via an 8-case jump-table switch (global 0x00526C88), inverting or composing them with F_4x4MatrixInversion / F_8SIMDMatrixPackedFloatOperation, optionally blending the input vector toward a4, then transforming it through F_4DVectorTransform.

MMX/3DNow! fixed-point pipeline that multiplies 16 packed 16-bit lanes, performs two rotation passes with lane reordering, then samples a byte-indexed surface lookup table for 8 destination texel slots; flushes MMX state with _m_empty() and returns the final sampled byte.

32-point Modified Discrete Cosine Transform over 32 input floats: folds samples into a shared static 64-float scratch buffer, runs four staged butterfly passes with a read-only cosine coefficient table, and de-interleaves 32 results into two 256-float sub-band output buffers. Called by the audio mixer path (caller 0x00531830) as the sub-band transform stage.

MMX sub-band-synthesis transform for the audio path: splits eight 64-bit input lanes into 16-bit halves, builds per-octave sum/difference terms, applies two banks of 16-row pmaddwd products against constant coefficient tables, folds with psrlqi/paddd, arithmetic-shifts right by 0xE, and stores 16-bit results into two output word buffers. Invoked by the audio resampler (caller 0x00532AA0).

SSE-accelerated 4x4 matrix transform of a single 3-component integer vector with implicit w=1: copies the four __m128 matrix columns from the argument into the column buffer at *(this+0x30), seeds the working vector buffer at *(this+0x10) with w=1, and computes the four-component dot product per column. Straight-line, no branches, no calls.

Batch vertex transform, structural twin of SSEMatrixVectorTransform (0x0053AE00): reads the batch count from a2[2], loops transforming source vertices (12-dword stride) through the 4-column SSE matrix-vector product into a 16-dword-stride output, then continues over the remainder of the source array with a 3-column product into a 5-dword-stride output.

Stores two consecutive dwords into a physics/vehicle state object: a2 at a3 + 5084 and the return-register value at a3 + 5088, then returns that second value. The __userpurge ABI reuses eax as the second stored value; a4 is unused.

Updates a scene node's collision and visibility state without setting a full world transform: branches on a node flag bit at this+0x3C, performs transform/bone copies through the scene-manager vtable, runs collision contact detection and AABB visibility classification, then finalizes rendering/material state according to node state flag bits.
Unconditionally zeroes dword this[7] (field 0x1C) of the physics-state object; arguments a2 and a3 are unused. No guards, globals, callees, or return value.

Transforms an array of 3D position vectors through a 4x4 matrix: stores the vertex count from this+0x8 into global dword_5DC470, then loops over the source vertices (this+0xC, 12-float stride) writing three transformed components per vertex into the output array (this+0x3C, 6-float stride). Called by ThinWrapperDropsA1 (0x0053ACF0).

Resolves a value through helper sub_5644B0 applied to global byte_5EA438 and feeds the same expression to both strcmp operands, then returns the negated comparison when the dword at dword_8D46B4 + 132 is zero. If sub_5644B0 is deterministic the comparison degenerates to zero.

Single-statement byte flag setter: ORs the char argument a1 into a byte at v3+94 (compound |=). The decompiled frame is flagged positive-sp, v3 is an uninitialized local, so the true base of the byte write is not established by this packet.

Iterates over a count of 580-byte joint structs referenced by this[1]; zeroes 12 consecutive DWORD work slots (DWORD indexes 77..88) in each, clearing constraint-solver scratch state. Called from PhysicsIntegrationStep on the frame path (caller 0x00441D60).

Executes one physics constraint-solver step for the batch: when no virtual solver object is installed it clears the constraint matrix row/column entries, runs the three-pass batch processing transform, transforms the inertia-tensor vector of every wheel body in the joint array (stride 580), reinitializes identity matrices for active batch bodies and constraints, then finishes through the vtable solve virtual or the non-virtual matrix-solve helper at 0x0056CD70.

Batch iteration helper (__thiscall): reads the element count from this+0x0; while positive, iterates that many element slots at base this+0x4 stepping 580 bytes and calls VehiclePhysicsStateCopyTransform on each slot. Called from StateAccumulateDelta (0x00441360). Returns the count read from this+0x0.

Destructor for a composite network/physics/IO object: installs the IOOps vtable (off_5B8A68) at this+0x0, tears down the network subsystem, walks eight guard-byte/HANDLE pairs closing each handle when guard and handle are set, destroys interleaved linked-list and buffer sub-objects, swaps in the physics vtable (off_5B8A00) at this+0x940, and chains into sub_583AE0(this) whose result is the return value.
Parameterless forwarding wrapper (vehicle subsystem): passes the address of global unk_8D4248 as the single argument to a locale-teardown destructor helper and returns the callee's result unchanged.

Stdcall forwarding thunk (vehicle subsystem): reads global dword_8D4210 as a base pointer, casts it to char*, and forwards it with the four incoming arguments a1..a4 to a vtable-fixup-with-destructor helper, returning its result unchanged.
Wrapper that returns the result of decrementing the reference count (with dead-object check) of the global physics-state object at 0x008D4438.

classes.name: SimdMatrixMath4x4
classes.responsibility: SIMD/3DNow!/MMX 4x4 matrix construction, composition, inversion-selection and vector transform over eight qword slots (row-major packed float pairs). Slot 7 (0x38) carries the homogeneous 1.0/1.0 packed constant; slots 0x30 and 0x38 double as translation storage. The 8-case dispatch in 0x00526B55 selects among up to three optional matrix inputs.

classes.name: FixedPointQuaternionTransform
classes.responsibility: MMX/3DNow! fixed-point pipeline that multiplies 16 packed 16-bit lanes of source data using fixed-point scale constants, performs two rotation passes with lane reordering, then samples a byte-indexed surface lookup table for 8 destination texel slots. The lane-to-component mapping is not grounded; the surface-table entry format is inferred.

classes.name: SseMatrixVectorTransform
classes.responsibility: SSE-accelerated 4x4 matrix-vector transform of 3-component vectors with implicit affine w=1, using a per-call working vector buffer at *(this+0x10) and a 16-byte-aligned matrix column buffer at *(this+0x30). The batch twin loops over vertex arrays with distinct output strides.

classes.name: Mdct32SubbandTransform
classes.responsibility: 32-point Modified Discrete Cosine Transform folding 32 samples through four staged butterfly passes into two 256-float sub-band output buffers. Uses a shared static 64-float scratch buffer (flt_8B5924..0x8B5A20) and a read-only cosine coefficient table (0x005B772C..0x005B77A4); the transform is therefore not re-entrant by construction.

classes.name: MmxSubbandSynthesisTransform
classes.responsibility: MMX sub-band synthesis for the audio resampler path: splits eight 64-bit input lanes into 16-bit halves, computes per-octave sum/difference terms, applies two banks of 16-row pmaddwd products against constant coefficient tables (unk_8D7200 rows, qword_8D7000 qwords), folds each 32-bit accumulation with psrlqi/paddd, arithmetic-shifts right by 0xE, and stores 16-bit results into two output word buffers.

classes.name: PhysicsStateSnapshot
classes.responsibility: Writes a two-dword state snapshot pair into a physics/vehicle state object at offsets +5084 and +5088. The __userpurge ABI passes the second value through the return register. The offsets are not packet-listed field refs and the owning class is unidentified.

classes.name: SceneNodeUpdate
classes.responsibility: Scene-node collision/visibility update without a full world transform: flag-bit dispatch at this+0x3C, transform and bone copies through the scene-manager vtable behind global 0x008B8F24, collision contact detection and AABB visibility classification, and mesh dirty-flag finalization according to node state flag bits.

classes.name: PhysicsStateFieldAccessor
classes.responsibility: Reads and writes individual state fields of a physics-state object. 0x005593C6 unconditionally zeroes dword 0x1C; 0x0056C2C4 OR-accumulates a flag byte into an unverified base (v3+94, frame flagged positive-sp).

classes.name: MatrixTransformVertices
classes.responsibility: Transforms a count of 3D position vectors (source at this+0xC, 12-float stride) through a 4x4 matrix into a 6-float-stride output (this+0x3C). Vertex count is stored into global dword_5DC470 before the loop.

classes.name: PhysicsObjectNameCompare
classes.responsibility: Resolves a value through helper sub_5644B0 applied to global byte_5EA438 and feeds the same expression to both strcmp operands; the returned comparison is negated when a flag dword at global object 0x8D46B4 + 132 is zero. If the helper is deterministic the comparison degenerates to zero.

classes.name: VehiclePhysicsSolver
classes.responsibility: Vehicle physics joint/constraint solver batch state: count and element-array pairs over 580-byte (0x244) joint elements, batch and constraint identity reinitialization, constraint-matrix row/column clearing, the three-pass batch processing transform, wheel-body inertia-tensor transforms, and the per-element work-field clearing run on the frame path. An optional virtual solver (this+0x30) overrides the non-virtual matrix-solve helper at 0x0056CD70.

classes.name: NetworkPhysicsCompositeObject
classes.responsibility: Composite network/physics/IO object: installs the IOOps vtable (off_5B8A68) at this+0x0, tears down the network subsystem, closes eight guard-byte/HANDLE resource pairs (4-byte stride, guard byte at handle+8), destroys interleaved linked-list and buffer sub-objects, swaps in the physics vtable (off_5B8A00) at this+0x940, and chains into final cleanup.

classes.name: VehicleSubsystemGlobalThunks
classes.responsibility: Thin forwarding shims of the vehicle subsystem that operate on module globals (0x008D4210, 0x008D4248, 0x008D4438), passing them to vtable-fixup, locale-teardown, and reference-count decrement helpers whose absolute addresses are not evidenced in the packet.

interfaces.name: SceneManagerTransformInterface
interfaces.purpose: Scene-manager interface reached through the global pointer at 0x008B8F24; vtable slot 1 copies a transform/matrix (used to copy node and bone transforms during the scene-node update). The exact operation is inferred from argument positions.

interfaces.name: PhysicsSolverVtableInterface
interfaces.purpose: Optional virtual solver interface of the physics batch solver, installed at this+0x30 of the solver state. vtable offset 0x14 (20) is the solve method, offset 0x1C (28) clears the constraint matrix; the non-virtual matrix-solve helper at 0x0056CD70 is used only when this interface is absent.

interfaces.name: CompositeNetworkPhysicsInterface
interfaces.purpose: The composite network/physics/IO object's public interfaces: the IOOps vtable at this+0x0 (off_5B8A68) and the physics vtable at this+0x940 (off_5B8A00), both swapped in during destruction to route the teardown chain.

compatibility_contracts.name: Matrix4x4EightQwordLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A 4x4 transform matrix is eight qword slots at base+0x0..0x38 (row-major packed float pairs). Slot 7 (base+0x38) carries the homogeneous packed constant 0x3F8000003F800000; slots base+0x30 and base+0x38 double as translation storage. 0x00522A6C, 0x00522CE2 and 0x0052466C depend on this layout; a replacement must preserve the packed-pair representation and the packed identity constant.

compatibility_contracts.name: SseBufferPointerSlots
compatibility_contracts.description: SSE matrix-vector transforms require a working vector buffer pointer at this+0x10 (four floats, w seeded to 1.0f / 1065353216) and a matrix column buffer at this+0x30 (four __m128 columns). 0x0053AE00 and 0x0053AEB0 depend on both buffers being valid for the transform.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleJointElementStride580
compatibility_contracts.description: Vehicle physics joint/work elements are 580 bytes (0x244) each, reached through the element array at this+0x4 with count at this+0x0; DWORD indexes 77..88 are per-element constraint-solver scratch cleared every frame, and each element's transform is copied by VehiclePhysicsStateCopyTransform. A replacement must preserve the 580-byte stride and the 12-slot work region.

compatibility_contracts.name: StaticScratchNonReentrantTransform
compatibility_contracts.description: Transform32PointMDCT (0x00531B50) uses a shared static 64-float scratch buffer (flt_8B5924..0x8B5A20) and a read-only cosine coefficient table (0x005B772C..0x005B77A4); it is not re-entrant and cannot be interleaved with itself on the audio path.

compatibility_contracts.name: GuardedHandleResourcePairPattern
compatibility_contracts.description: The composite network/physics/IO object exposes eight resource pairs at 4-byte stride where the Win32 HANDLE sits 8 bytes before its guard byte; a slot is closed (CloseHandle) and zeroed only when both the guard byte and the handle are set. Replacement teardown must preserve this pairing and the guard semantics.
